g.text: | LOCAL-FIRST FAIL-CLOSED APPSEC GATE & ISOLATED RUNTIME ENGINE
Zero-cloud local workstation execution, hook interception & terminal lifecycle
Live interactive spinners, findings table, markdown formatting & colored progress bars
If any scanner container crashes, times out, or emits malformed output, Kuro fails closed.
Security gates never silently bypass or default to pass under partial failure states.
PLANE B : SANDBOX HARDENING, POLICY GATE & ATTESTATION
Zero-privilege container isolation, deterministic evaluation & provenance signature
Attaches git commit SHA & policy digest
Zero external PKI or cloud dependencies
